caption: The drawing features a rectangular area composed of two distinct patterns. On the left and lower parts, there is a dense arrangement of large, detailed flowers and leaves. The flowers are predominantly pink with hints of red and white, and are accompanied by green, serrated leaves. There are also purple clusters that resemble grapes and several blue and orange leaves interspersed throughout. The right portion of the drawing displays a geometric quilt-like pattern consisting of hexagonal shapes outlined in a pale beige or cream color. Within these hexagons, clusters of smaller hexagons form rosette or flower-like arrangements. Some of these clusters are in green plaid, brown and beige, or patterned with floral motifs in the center. The two patterns partially overlap in the center of the drawing, where the floral and geometric areas meet, creating a contrast between organic and structured forms. The overall color palette includes shades of pink, green, red, blue, purple, orange, brown, and beige. The background is an unadorned, off-white color.
title: Quilted Bedspread
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
